entries.title: Tasks on another computer open and merge their work after the move to Infinitary
entries.body: A task that started on another computer before Infinitary moved your saved work out of Firstmate 3000's folder can now finish. A task with Careful care opens its pull request. A task set to local merge merges. Before, the app looked for the task's work in the old folder and stopped with an error.
entries.noPicture: What changes is that a crewmate's pull request opens and a merge goes through; no screen changes.
